spec.name: sprint42_taker_imbalance_btceth_60m
spec.hypothesis: Extreme 5-minute taker buy/sell imbalance in BTC/ETH predicts continuation over the next 60 minutes, net of T1 fees.
spec.power_argument: 2 symbols x cap 3/day x >=60 validation days = >=360 expected trades (>=300). Assuming per-trade net sd ~60bps, SE ~3.2bps at n=360, so min detectable net edge ~10bps at t=3. Null expectation is negative (fees), so the criterion can fail. Smoke check: abort as INVALID if loader returns n=0 on the train window.
